experiment.name: Where natural B. rossi dogs lie relative to the Beagle reference course: replication in the two DS03 cohorts
experiment.description: Does the disease-space geometry seen in DS05 repeat in the DS03 referral-hospital cohorts? The share of dogs within the Beagle band and the pseudo-stage distribution are reported per cohort; DS03 has no outcome.
experiment.summary: Geometry only (DS03 has no outcome). Within 2 spread units of the Beagle course: cohort 1 20% (95% CI 13% to 30%, n 85), cohort 2 17% (n 18), against DS05 24%; projected onto an end of the course: 61%, 83% and 61%. No tests.

payload.footnote: DS02 (5 Beagles, SRC-B) and DS03 (SRC-E): natural cohorts 1 and 2 (n 103), healthy controls and IMHA dogs as reference. No outcome in DS03. One species, one country.

sections.heading: Question
paragraphs: Does the geometry seen in DS05 (where natural dogs sit relative to the Beagle course) repeat in the two natural-infection cohorts of DS03, a referral hospital series with no severity score?

sections.heading: What was done
paragraphs: The DS03 dogs were projected onto the same Beagle course as SV-01-01 (spec construction, with the time-anchored course as a sensitivity). For each cohort: share within 2 spread units (Wilson 95% CI), share projected onto an end of the course, and the pseudo-stage distribution. Healthy controls and IMHA dogs of DS03 are projected as reference groups. No test between DS03 and DS05: different sources and settings (clinic against referral hospital).

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: Cohort 1 (n 85): 20% within the band (95% CI 13% to 30%), 61% on an end (95% CI 51% to 71%), median haematocrit 0.18.
Cohort 2 (n 18): 17% within (95% CI 6% to 39%), 83% on an end, median haematocrit 0.14.
DS05 for comparison (n 147): 24% within, 61% on an end. Healthy controls: 14% within, none on an end.
Time-anchored course: within the band 41% (cohort 1), 17% (cohort 2), 40% (DS05); past the late end 55%, 44% and 54%.
The geometry repeats: in both settings most naturally infected dogs lie outside the range that the 5 Beagles covered before treatment, mainly because they are more anaemic.

sections.heading: What this does not show
paragraphs: Nothing about severity: DS03 has no outcome. The pseudo-stage is not validated (SV-01-01).

DS03 "Day 1" in the experimental file is day 1 after inoculation of the same 5 Beagles; those records were not used. Overlap of DS03 dogs with S-CB050 or S-CB517 is possible and unverified. One species, one country; prior treatment unknown.
